---
title: "Installation"
description: "Install the current ProtVis development release and launch the application."
---

## Requirements

ProtVis is an R package with a Shiny interface. Use a recent R installation and a writable R library. On Windows, installing packages from source may also require the matching Rtools release when a binary is unavailable.

::: {.callout-note}
This cookbook currently follows **ProtVis 0.7.9 on the `dev` branch**. The installation commands below therefore install `@dev` explicitly.
:::

## Recommended installation

Install `pak` once, then install ProtVis from GitHub:

```r
options(repos = c(
  CRAN = "https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/CRAN/"
))

install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("xuebinzhang-lab/ProtVis@dev")
```

Verify the installed version:

```r
packageVersion("ProtVis")
# 0.7.9 for the cookbook baseline
```

Because `dev` changes continuously, a later installation may report a newer version. In that case, prefer the current ProtVis source and Help page when a control or default differs from this cookbook.

## Clean update

When an old installation is stale, locked, or its lazy-load database is corrupted, use the clean installer supplied by ProtVis:

```r
source(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xuebinzhang-lab/ProtVis/dev/install_ProtVis.R"
)
```

Close other R sessions that are currently using ProtVis before running a clean reinstall.

## Sage availability

Raw/mzML projects can run a Sage database search from the conditional **Search** tab.

On Windows, ProtVis first looks for its bundled executable at `inst/extdata/sage/windows/sage.exe`. On Linux or macOS, install Sage separately and make the `sage` executable available on `PATH`. You can verify discovery from R with:

```r
ProtVis::protvis_sage_executable()
```

A valid path means the search engine is available. `NULL` means ProtVis could not locate Sage.

## Optional WGCNA helper

Some WGCNA workflows may use the optional helper package documented by ProtVis:

```r
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ShawnWx2019/WGCNAShinyFun", ref = "master")
```

You do not need this optional dependency to launch the core application.

## Launch ProtVis

```r
library(ProtVis)
run_ProtVis()
```

or directly:

```r
ProtVis::run_ProtVis()
```

## First launch checklist

After the application opens, confirm that you can see **Homepage**, **Project init**, **Pre-processing**, **Downstream analysis**, **Multi-omics**, **PTM**, **Release data**, **Toolkits**, and **Help**.

Two navigation items are intentionally conditional:

- **Search** is shown when **Raw** is selected in Project init.
- **Pre-processing → MaxQuant Output Preparation** is shown only when **MaxQuant** is selected.

The source-independent preprocessing items, including **Correct Noise**, remain available for all supported data sources.

If the app opens but an optional module reports a missing dependency, install that dependency and restart the R session. If the package itself fails to load after an update, prefer the clean installer above rather than repeatedly installing over a corrupted package directory.
